title: CHAPTER 1: THE BLAZON OF THE RIVERLANDS // HERALDIC EXCURSION
narrative: As Jaime rode past the ruined inn at the crossroads, his squire pointed out a battered shield hanging from an oak branch. It bore a chevron gules between three martlets sable upon a field of vair. Jaime paused his entire military campaign to recount forty minutes of Riverlands genealogical history: how the second son of House Darry had married a Bracken bastard during the Third Blackfyre Rebellion, resulting in a bitter coat-of-arms dispute over two watermills in the Year of the False Spring. Brienne shifted in her saddle. 'Ser Jaime, Lady Stoneheart has a noose waiting.' 'Patience, Brienne,' Jaime replied. 'The readers need to understand the heraldic significance of this marsh hen.'
